items.title: XRP Ledger is set to fix its lending code before anyone can use it
items.summary: Validators have a bug-fix patch on course to go live Friday. The lending system it partly repairs is still 10 votes short of approval.

items.title: Crypto vault deposits top $10 billion as lending risks draw regulatory scrutiny
items.summary: Curator-managed lending strategies are attracting institutional capital, while exposing depositors to collateral, liquidity and smart-contract risks.

items.title: Bitcoin, Korea’s Kospi and Nasdaq futures rally as China GDP beats estimates
items.summary: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures and Asian stocks rally as stronger-than-expected China GDP and falling oil prices lift risk appetite.

items.title: Made an ‘honest’ mistake with crypto taxes? New bill offers way out
items.summary: A proposed US bill would let crypto investors correct past tax reporting mistakes through a dedicated disclosure program, with reduced penalties for eligible taxpayers.

items.title: Ledger’s early implant warnings deserved more action, Karpelès says
items.summary: Ledger was contacted about tampered hardware wallets risks months before its latest security crisis, with former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès questioning its response.

items.title: Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson is building a new programming language for the network
items.summary: Hoskinson said on X the language will bundle transaction requests with cryptographic proofs. He hasn’t shared a name, specs or a release date.

items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 19, 2026

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin edges higher as U.S. stocks rebound early Monday
items.summary: Tech futures bounced after last week’s 5.5% rout; earnings this week put the AI trade to the test again.

items.title: Bitcoin extends bounce above $82,000 as stocks rebound, DeFi tokens lead altcoin gains
items.summary: Bitcoin rose 0.8% to around $82,700 as China’s GDP beat estimates and Nasdaq futures rebounded, while the CoinDesk 80 gained 1.3% and DeFi led gains.

items.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin, representing dollar deposits, to Ethereum
items.summary: JPMorgan's dollar deposit token is heading to Ethereum as the lender looks to offer it to wider selection of institutional clients.

items.title: Bitcoin mining offshoot Nscale loses Microsoft AI deal as power delay stretches into 2030s
items.summary: The Nvidia-backed company planned to deliver 23,000 AI chips in the U.K. next year, but its grid connection may not be ready until the 2030s.

items.title: Bitcoin whale moves $34 million in BTC it got in 2013 when coins traded at $131
items.summary: A bitcoin wallet dormant since 2013 moved 411 BTC, now worth about $34 million. It is one of several long-dormant wallets to wake up recently.

items.title: Zcash developers plan a fix to keep ZEC swaps private from future quantum computers
items.summary: The team behind Zakura wants every swap through NEAR Intents to get its own key, so a refund address left on NEAR’s public chain can’t expose a user’s wider payment history.

items.title: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
items.summary: The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.

items.title: Public companies object to OKX-ICE’s tokenized stock plan
items.summary: Nine public companies objected to having their shares offered in tokenized form by OKX and ICE, testing whether platforms can create blockchain-based markets without issuer consent.

items.title: Strategy buys $22M in Bitcoin, repurchases $193M in STRC
items.summary: Strategy added 267 Bitcoin to its holdings as it bought back 1.94 million STRC shares and boosted its preferred stock buyback program to $3 billion.

items.title: World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin sheds $400M in market cap in two weeks
items.summary: World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin saw its market cap decrease more than $400 million over two weeks of large redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain.
